answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using proof of space-time, requiring nodes to allocate persistent storage plots to validate identities. Agents submit proofs at a network wharf, refracting integrity checks through a cryptographic prism to verify continuous sector retention. An adversary cannot flood the system like a surging river, because each alias demands the scarce cost of dedicated disk capacity. However, this mechanism favors industrial server farms with cheap bulk storage.
